Subject: Procurement kickoff + demo: multi-stakeholder scheduling

Hi Samuel / Acme team,

Thanks for engaging — really excited to get this started. We'd like to combine a short platform demo with a procurement kickoff to cover the vendor intake checklist, security Qs, and timeline for procurement approvals. Goal: leave with a clear next-steps list and calendar placeholders for technical deep-dive and contract/procurement work.

Proposed 90-minute window (we can split 30/60 if you prefer):
- Option A: Tue Aug 3, 10:00–11:30 PT / 1:00–2:30 ET
- Option B: Wed Aug 4, 14:00–15:30 PT / 5:00–6:30 ET
- Option C: Thu Aug 5, 08:30–10:00 PT / 11:30–1:00 ET (early slot)

Agenda (suggested)
- 0:00–0:30 — Executive demo (AE + product)
- 0:30–1:00 — Procurement & contracting checklist (procurement + legal)
- 1:00–1:30 — Technical deep-dive for Eng/Security (SE + Security)

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (high-level intake + docs we typically need).

Who from your side should we expect on the call (procurement contact + lead engineer)? Also flag any compliance docs you need up front (SOC 2, insurance, FedRAMP questions etc.).

I'll loop Karthik (SE) and Mina (Security) so we can align on availability. If none of the windows work, please propose 2x one-hour windows next week and we'll slot accordingly.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (7 pages)
From: Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@acme-corp.com>

Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff + demo: multi-stakeholder scheduling

Hi Priya — thanks for the options. Quick note: the team is pretty full early this week. Proposed alternatives (ET):
- Option 1: Tue Aug 10, 15:00–16:00 ET (60m)
- Option 2: Wed Aug 11, 10:00–11:00 ET (60m)
- Option 3: Thu Aug 12, 12:30–13:30 ET (60m)

We'd prefer a tighter format: 30m exec demo + 30m procurement + a follow-up technical deep-dive with engineers. Procurement would like to see SOC 2 type II, certificate of insurance, standard T&Cs (or a redlines summary), and an estimated procurement timeline. I've looped our procurement alias.

Also: can you share a procurement intake form (if you have one) and a single-slide summary of the technical requirements so our SRE/eng can pre-read?

Thanks Sam — understood on the tighter format, sounds good.

We can do a 60-minute slot but will structure it as 30m exec/demo + 30m procurement. SE (Karthik) and Security (Mina) will stay for the procurement portion and then we can schedule a separate engineers deep-dive within 48–72 hours. Proposed follow-up ET windows that match your suggestions:
- Final A: Tue Aug 10, 15:00–16:00 ET
- Final B: Wed Aug 11, 10:00–11:00 ET

I've attached a Procurement_Timeline_Template.xlsx and re-attached the onboarding checklist for your intake folks. Also linking our quick SOC 2 summary and sample MSA in the thread (see HubSpot links). If you prefer a DocuSign PO early, we can provide a pre-filled DocuSign once scope and seat counts are agreed.
